# Confirm Booking

## Summary
Moves a booking's attendance intent to Going — the purchase-complete /
"see you there" transition. Shared-realm command at `confirm-booking.gts`.

## API
Input: `booking` (linksTo Booking), `realm`. Result: the booking and a
message. An already-Going booking is reported, not re-written; transitions
the RSVP graph refuses are errors, not forced writes. Re-fetches the
booking before reading it.

## Usage
Call after whatever your domain counts as commitment: payment cleared, a
seat picked, a guest list approved. Chain your own moves (points, emails)
after the result.

## Example
The linked Booking is the natural target — a paid, Going booking shaped by
this command.

## Non-goals
Deliberately does not touch `paymentStatus`: money is a different fact
with its own writer, and coupling them would make every free event wrong.
Not the check-in — arrival is the Check In Booking command's fact.
